name: Hyperscale SSD Framework CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

env:
  SITE_DIR: site

jobs:
  test:
    name: Run tests on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]

    outputs:
      test_outcome: ${{ steps.run_behave_tests.outputs.test_outcome }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: 3.11

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install allure-behave
          if [[ "${{ matrix.os }}" == "Linux" ]]; then
            sudo apt-get update
            sudo apt-get install -y jq
          else
            choco install jq -y || true
          fi

      - name: Run Behave Tests
        id: run_behave_tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OS_NAME=${{ matrix.os }}
          BUILD_NUMBER=${{ github.run_number }}
          REPORT_DIR="reports/$BUILD_NUMBER/$OS_NAME"
          mkdir -p "$REPORT_DIR"

          echo "Running Behave tests on $OS_NAME..."
          TEST_EXIT_CODE=0
          behave --tags=@adv --exclude "features/manual_tests" \
            --format allure_behave.formatter:AllureFormatter \
            -o "$REPORT_DIR" --no-capture | tee "$REPORT_DIR/behave.log" || TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?

          # Extract scenario counts from last line of behave output
          SUMMARY_LINE=$(tail -n 5 "$REPORT_DIR/behave.log" | grep -E 'scenarios? passed' || true)
          PASSED=$(echo "$SUMMARY_LINE" | grep -oP '(\d+) scenarios? passed' | grep -oP '\d+' || echo 0)
          FAILED=$(echo "$SUMMARY_LINE" | grep -oP '(\d+) failed' | grep -oP '\d+' || echo 0)
          SKIPPED=$(echo "$SUMMARY_LINE" | grep -oP '(\d+) skipped' | grep -oP '\d+' || echo 0)
          BROKEN=$(echo "$SUMMARY_LINE" | grep -oP '(\d+) undefined' | grep -oP '\d+' || echo 0)

          # Determine PASS / UNSTABLE / FAIL
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
            if [ "$FAILED" -gt 0 ] || [ "$BROKEN" -gt 0 ]; then
              RESULT=UNSTABLE
            else
              RESULT=FAIL
            fi
          else
            RESULT=PASS
          fi

          echo "Detected result: $RESULT"
          echo "test_outcome=$RESULT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          # Only generate Allure report if PASS or UNSTABLE
          if [ "$RESULT" != "FAIL" ]; then
            allure generate "$REPORT_DIR" -o "$REPORT_DIR/html" --clean
          fi

          # Write summary.json for dashboard
          jq -n --argjson p "$PASSED" --argjson f "$FAILED" --argjson u "$BROKEN" \
            '{statistic: {passed: $p, failed: $f, unstable: $u}}' > "$REPORT_DIR/summary.json"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: reports/${{ github.run_number }}/${{ matrix.os }}/

  report:
    name: Generate Reports & Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install JQ
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Restore site history
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: history
          path: previous-site || true

      - name: Merge previous builds
        shell: bash
        run: |
          SITE_DIR="${{ env.SITE_DIR }}"
          mkdir -p "$SITE_DIR"
          if [ -d "previous-site" ]; then
            for D in previous-site/*; do
              [ -e "$D" ] || continue
              rsync -a "$D/" "$SITE_DIR/" || true
            done
          fi

      - name: Download current test results
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: reports

      - name: Generate dashboard JSON and HTML
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SITE_DIR="${{ env.SITE_DIR }}"
          BUILD_NUMBER=${{ github.run_number }}
          mkdir -p "$SITE_DIR/$BUILD_NUMBER"

          OS_LIST="ubuntu-latest windows-latest"
          DASHBOARD_JSON="$SITE_DIR/history.json"
          > "$DASHBOARD_JSON"

          echo "[]" > "$DASHBOARD_JSON.tmp"
          for OS in $OS_LIST; do
            SRC="reports/$BUILD_NUMBER/$OS/summary.json"
            if [ -f "$SRC" ]; then
              jq --slurpfile existing "$DASHBOARD_JSON.tmp" --argjson new "$(cat "$SRC")" \
                '$existing + [$new]' > "$DASHBOARD_JSON.tmp2"
              mv "$DASHBOARD_JSON.tmp2" "$DASHBOARD_JSON.tmp"
            fi
          done

          mv "$DASHBOARD_JSON.tmp" "$DASHBOARD_JSON"

          # Generate latest report links
          mkdir -p "$SITE_DIR/latest"
          for OS in $OS_LIST; do
            if [ -d "reports/$BUILD_NUMBER/$OS/html" ]; then
              mkdir -p "$SITE_DIR/latest/$OS"
              cp -R "reports/$BUILD_NUMBER/$OS/html/"* "$SITE_DIR/latest/$OS/"
            fi
          done

      - name: Upload Pages Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ${{ env.SITE_DIR }}

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

      - name: Upload History Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: history
          path: ${{ env.SITE_DIR }}
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Add Workflow Summary (Badges)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          PAGE_URL=${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
          BASE_URL="${PAGE_URL%/}"
          TEST_STATUS=${{ needs.test.outputs.test_outcome }}

          if [[ "$TEST_STATUS" == "FAIL" ]]; then
            STATUS_ICON="❌"
            STATUS_TEXT="Failed (setup/config error)"
          elif [[ "$TEST_STATUS" == "UNSTABLE" ]]; then
            STATUS_ICON="⚠️"
            STATUS_TEXT="Unstable (some tests failed)"
          else
            STATUS_ICON="✅"
            STATUS_TEXT="All tests passed"
          fi

          echo "### 🤖 Hyperscale SSD Framework CI/CD" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[![Ubuntu Latest Report](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ubuntu-Latest_Build-blue)](${BASE_URL}/latest/ubuntu-latest/index.html)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[![Windows Latest Report](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-Latest_Build-blue)](${BASE_URL}/latest/windows-latest/index.html)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[![Report History](https://img.shields.io/badge/All-Builds-green)](${BASE_URL}/)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "Build #${{ github.run_number }} | Status: $STATUS_ICON $STATUS_TEXT" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
